title: Back-to-back bookings refused by the wrong comparison
prompt: A guest can't book room 12 from July 10 to July 12, although the previous guest checks out on July 10: BookingService says the room is taken. The check-out day is free for the next guest. Fix it.
check: hidden java-booking-overlap && rm -rf out && javac -d out *.java && java -cp out BookingServiceTest && java -cp out BookingHiddenTest
